messages:
lena: Heads-up: after the policy hot-reload this morning we saw a subtle spike in hedged requests in prod (approx +1.9%). Not huge but reproducible. Initial signal points to inconsistent policy snapshots across router replicas.
oscar: saw same in canary. logs show router:decision_epoch_local=31045 vs incoming_decision_epoch=31046 leading to 'epoch_mismatch' path and hedged forks.
priya: quick context: policy-service writes snapshots and then publishes a short notification. Routers pull snapshots on a background loop. There's a small propagation window where some routers have new epoch and some don't.
ben_k: idea: add a decision-epoch header on request (X-Decision-Epoch). When a request hits a router that has a different epoch, we can choose to either: 1) prefer local epoch (fast but inconsistent), 2) wait briefly for a matching-route (consistent but may add latency), 3) use explicit fallback rules. We should weigh capacity fragmentation vs tail-latency.
lena: operationally we want minimal customer-visible regressions. Proposal sketch:
- routers attach their current epoch to outbound decisions in responses as explainability metadata.
- add a per-tenant policy flag: routing.epoch_strictness = ["allow", "prefer", "strict" ]
- default = prefer. prefer: prefer same-epoch candidate but if none available within 6ms, fall back to best-effort route. strict: wait up to 20ms+quorum window or failover. allow: immediate.
priya: metrics to add: routing.epoch_mismatch.count, routing.epoch_wait_ms.p50/p95, routing.hedge_rate_by_epoch. Also track capacity-utilization-per-epoch.
ioscar: probe behavior: our synthetic probes are amplifying this. Probes should carry origin_epoch and be ignored for hedging decisions if origin_epoch < local_epoch - 1. That avoids probe-induced hedges.
ben_k: rollout plan: 1) add epoch header and explainability fields to responses (non-breaking), 2) enable prefer mode in staging + observability, 3) run mixed-epoch sim for 12h, 4) canary 1% with strict for a small tenant cohort, monitor hedges and p99, 5) ramp.
infra-bot: "policy-service v3 deployed to prod at 2026-03-25T09:04:12Z"
priya: implementation notes: use atomic write of snapshot file + publish snapshot_id on pubsub. Routers should do a lightweight pull-on-notify to reduce loop lag. Also add short backoff jitter to avoid thundering herd.
ben_k: important: keep backward compatibility. Old routers without epoch header should be treated as epoch=0. New routers should avoid aggressive strictness until api-gateways and edge caches roll.
lena: follow-ups: priya to open RFC follow-up with sequence diagram and sim harness config. ben_k will own telemetry dashboard. oscar + priya will pair on probe suppression patch.
PRIYA: ping me for pairing.
